title: ringswim-waste: ring-walled Allen-Cahn cells from noise that swim (per-body phoresis) and divide, bounded by a self-made waste
summary: phase_membrane's chi-ringed cells plus phase_swimdiv's per-body phoretic drift and a waste that exits only through the wall. From noise on 3 seeds a bounded population of walled cells swims as crescents (21-36 track segments >= 3 BL; 0 with mu=0) and divides (28-34 persistent splits, generation 12-16 by an overlap tracker; reticulate, merges 55-80% of splits) to t=20000. The link ring holds at rim/core 1.49/1.27/1.59 (1.15 with chi=0). Weak points: reticulate genealogy, label-based drive, ring weakened by swimming.

claims.statement: From noise (seeds 0-2), walled cells swim >= 3 body lengths by their own phoretic drift and divide repeatedly; daughters of divisions swim off.
claims.track: seed 1, celltrack tracks 125 > 126 > 136 (strip_s1.png row 1): pinch at t~11100, 126 pinches again at t~12100, daughter 136 swims 7.9 BL

controls_run.M: pack_mu0/ and data/celltrack_mu0_s0.json, data/celltrack_mu0_s1.json (mu=0: 0 segments >= 3 BL)

claims.statement: The moving cells carry a material link ring at the wall (L rim/core 1.49 / 1.27 / 1.59 on seeds 0-2) that the chi=0 twin lacks (1.15).
claims.track: seed 2, labkit top track #502 (pack/seed2/tracks.png, t=16000-18300): ringed cell that becomes a swimming crescent
